overview.viewsChartDetail: Per day, by the language shown

articles.title: Articles
articles.description: By topic, in {{languages}}. A reader sees their language, and {{default}} where no translation exists.
articles.noneDetail: Write the first one, or import Markdown or HTML from another help center.

article.failed: The article could not be loaded.
article.noVersionDetail: Readers of this language see the {{language}} article, the default language, until one is written.
article.answeredDetail_one: {{count}} form or chat closed after it this month
article.answeredDetail_other: {{count}} forms and chats closed after it this month

import.title: Import articles
import.description: Markdown or HTML files from another help center. Each file becomes a draft.
import.hint: Markdown front matter may give title, topic, lang, slug and plans. An HTML page's title or first heading is the title; scripts, styles and forms are removed.
import.doneSkipped_one: {{count}} draft imported; {{skipped}} skipped as too long.
import.doneSkipped_other: {{count}} drafts imported; {{skipped}} skipped as too long.

editor.sentForReview: Sent for review. A second person approves it before readers see it.
editor.inReviewDetail: Approve or send it back under To review. Changing it takes it back to draft.
editor.inReviewOwn: You sent it for review, so someone else approves it. Changing it takes it back to draft.
editor.liveDraftDetail: These changes reach the help center once they are reviewed.
editor.bodyHint: Steps, links and images by their https address. Scripts, styles and forms are removed before anyone sees it.
editor.readersPlans: Only customers on these plans, with a reader link from your app.
editor.unpublished: Taken off the help center; the words stay as a draft.
editor.deleteDetail: The article, its languages, its views and its answers are deleted. This cannot be undone.

review.title: To review
review.description: An article is public once a second person reviews it. Drafts and articles in review are seen only by the team.
review.descriptionNoReview: The settings file lets writers publish their own articles; articles sent here can still be approved or sent back.
review.changesMarked: Changes since the published version are marked. The article asks readers whether it helped once it is published.
review.newArticle: A new article. It asks readers whether it helped once it is published.
review.backDetail: {{name}} sees your note on the article.

gaps.title: Gaps
gaps.description: Searches that found nothing, in the help center, the ticket form and the chat window, the last 30 days.
gaps.noneDetail: Every search in the last 30 days found an article.
gaps.dialogTitle: Write an article for this search
gaps.linkedHint: The search is linked to the draft, so the gap closes once the article is written.
gaps.created: Draft "{{title}}" created for {{owner}}, linked to the search "{{query}}".

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.description: The ticket form and the chat window suggest articles as people type. A question counts as answered when the form or chat is closed after reading.
suggestions.tryDetail: The ticket form, as a customer sees it. What you type here is not kept.
suggestions.subject: Subject
suggestions.typeSome: Type a few words, as a customer would.
suggestions.noMatch: No article matches yet; from a real form the search is kept for Gaps.
suggestions.noneDetail: Add the suggest script to the ticket form and the chat window under Integrations.
suggestions.helpdeskNote: Agents in Helpdesk see the same suggestions beside a ticket and can send an article in a reply. Live Chat shows them in the window before a chat starts.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Where the help center's articles are suggested, and where its visits are measured.
integrations.helpdeskDetail: One script tag; the field marked data-openasy-kb gets suggestions under it. Sending the form counts as a ticket.
integrations.chatDetail: Attach to the message field and say how the chat ended.
integrations.apiDetail: Helpdesk asks the same API for the suggestions agents see beside a ticket.
integrations.analyticsOff: Off. Name an Analytics site's script in the settings file to measure help center visits there.
integrations.sitesDetail: Origins in suggest.sites; their pages may read suggestions, and what they send is kept for the reports.
integrations.noSites: None yet: add the ticket form's and chat window's origins to suggest.sites.
integrations.readersDetail: Your app signs a reader token with the key in {{key}} and links the customer here; see the README.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Set in {{file}} with the rest of the install. Shown here as applied; changed in the file, not here.
settings.readOnlyDetail: Edit the file and commit it. The product reads it again within a minute and lists any line it could not apply. Members and sign-in are managed under their own pages.
settings.noFile: # No settings file is applied: the defaults are in use.
settings.notApplied: The file on disk is not applied
settings.name: Name
settings.reviewOn: A second person approves before an article is public
settings.helpfulValue_one: Articles under {{share}}% helpful are listed for their owner, from {{count}} answer
settings.helpfulValue_other: Articles under {{share}}% helpful are listed for their owner, from {{count}} answers

auth.askAnAdmin: Ask an admin of this Knowledge Base.
auth.accountDetail: Your name, password, second factor and passkeys.
auth.membersDetail: Who may use this Knowledge Base, and their role: viewers read, editors write and review, admins manage.
auth.signinDetail: How people sign in: with a password, or through your identity provider.
auth.tokensDetail: Tokens for scripts, each with one role and an expiry.
